reader_question: How many citizens report voting in presidential years?
title: In every presidential year from 1980 to 2024, between 58 and 68 percent of citizens 18 and over reported voting.
measure_line: Share of citizens 18 and over who reported voting, presidential years from 1980, the first the survey counted citizens alone, to 2024, United States
source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, Current Population Survey Voting and Registration Supplement, Table A-1, reported voting, citizen voting-age population, November 1978 to 2024, United States. Retrieved November 6, 2026. Self-reported in a survey; citizenship data before 1996 are not fully comparable.
alt: Columns from zero for each presidential year from 1980 to 2024, all of similar height, from 58.4 percent in 1996 to 67.7 percent in 1992.

table.caption: Share of citizens who reported voting, presidential years, percent

notes_internal: Rule 14.4's correct plate. Checked by script: lowest 58.4 (1996), highest 67.7 (1992).
